t: Above you is Angels of the Heavenly Host, a mosaic mural by Charles Lutyens, made between 1963 and 1968. Lutyens, who lived from 1933 to 2021, was an English artist and art therapist. So this is a big piece of work, taking about five years to complete. Step back to take in the whole composition, then move closer to see the individual pieces of the mosaic.
